content: This medication must not be used during pregnancy. Weight loss provides no benefit to a pregnant woman and may harm the unborn baby. It is unknown if this drug passes into breast milk; however, similar drugs are known to do so. Therefore, breastfeeding is not recommended while using this medication. Drug interactions can alter how your medications work or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not list all possible drug interactions. It is important to maintain a list of all products you use, including prescription, non-prescription, and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. This medication should not be used with certain drugs due to the risk of severe interactions. Taking monoamine oxidase (MAO) inhibitors with this medication can result in a serious, potentially fatal interaction. Avoid using MAO inhibitors (e.g., isocarboxazid, linezolid, methylene blue, phenelzine, selegiline, tranylcypromine) during treatment with this drug. Most MAO inhibitors should also not be taken for two weeks before starting this medication. Caffeine can amplify the side effects of this medication. In the event of an overdose with serious symptoms such as unconsciousness or difficulty breathing, call emergency services (911) immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. Appetite suppressants should not replace a proper diet. Do not share this medication with others. Keep all medical and lab appointments. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is near the time of your next dose or late in the evening, skip the missed dose and resume your regular schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this medication and your specific health needs.
